scope: Full React Compiler cleanup series, including its final native-map deferral record.
conclusion: No behavior regressions found in the reviewed source and routine mocked verification scope.

originalSeries.subject: fix: resolve three React Compiler optimization diagnostics
refactor: make immutable snapshots compatible with React Compiler
refactor: resolve five React Compiler syntax diagnostics
refactor: resolve optional React Compiler camera diagnostic
refactor: resolve three React Compiler lifecycle diagnostics
docs: record native-map React Compiler deferral

provenance.squash: The original series is consolidated into the commit containing this record. Earlier evidence remains historical; its intermediate revision IDs refer to pre-squash history. Final source hashes identify the implementation preserved in the consolidated commit.

inspectedBehavior: Frozen first values, including functions and undefined; creation-option validation; source attachment identity across rerenders and replacement.
Web padding omission, zero reset, repeated removal, remount and suspended rendering; native ornament management history and selected SDK overrides.
Deferred proxy identity, promise assimilation, command forwarding, detachment and replacement attachments.
Native camera synchronous dispatch ownership, reentrant command notification, pending acknowledgements, feedback-loop guards and teardown.
Geolocation watch acquisition/release, synchronous callbacks, overlapping camera requests, committed inputs, generation changes, cancellation, retry and stale completion.
Image revision and registration ownership, sprite receiver binding, sdf omission/false, replacement, reentrant callbacks and cleanup.
Marker projection and drag result ordering; navigation errors and replacement; scale readback and teardown; source/map click query ordering and failure propagation.

verification.auditCodeChanges: None. The audit compared the combined series with its base and inspected connected callers and tests.

additionalProbe.method: Extracted the actual baseline and current padding/ornament hooks in memory and ran them with React and jsdom. No repository test files were added.
additionalProbe.result: Abandoned transitions did not latch ornament management or consume padding resets. Committed updates and remount outcomes agreed between the baseline and current hooks.

diagnosticDisposition.remaining: Both native-map ref-capture groups remain intentionally deferred.

verification.warnings: Existing TypeScript experimental build-API and Bun moduleSuffixes warnings remain. The isolated hook probe used the experimental Node stripTypeScriptTypes API.

limitations: No renderer acceptance, real-renderer smoke tests, native builds or installations ran during the audit. Runtime acceptance is not renewed.
No performance benchmark ran; fewer diagnostics do not establish a measured performance gain.
The review and mocked tests found no regression in the inspected paths; they do not prove all runtime behavior equivalent.
